name: @blokjs/runtime-worker
description: Persistent JavaScript/TypeScript execution worker for Blok — serves blok.runtime.v1 over gRPC under Node.js, Bun, or Deno.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run tsc && bun run sync:proto
scripts.sync:proto: mkdir -p dist/proto/blok/runtime/v1 dist/conformance && cp src/proto/blok/runtime/v1/runtime.proto dist/proto/blok/runtime/v1/runtime.proto && cp src/conformance/data.json dist/conformance/data.json
